infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Volo uses your location to find nearby rides and show your pickup point to the driver.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Volo needs background location during an active trip so the driver and rider can share live location for safety and accurate tracking.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Volo uses your camera to capture your ID document for driver verification (KYC).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Volo needs access to your photo library to upload your ID document for driver verification (KYC).
